title: East Nashville Refuge - Where Culture Meets Nature
description:
Gorgeous light-filled private guest suite surrounded by nature awaits you in Music City. This is a great place to stay for couples who want to explore all that Nashville has to offer. Our property backs up to a very large park which means you are just steps away from greenways and nature trails. Close to everything but secluded for when you need to recharge your batteries. Private entrance, private suite with bathroom and large closet.

The space
Private suite with separate entrance. Guests have access to front porch to view the wildlife or just drink a cup of coffee.  Very comfortable bed and close to all downtown and East Nashville attractions.

Guest access
Access to private suite, bathroom and large closet. Also access to front porch to relax.
